group_by.description: Single group field. Kept for backward compatibility.

group_by_fields.description: Preferred multi-field grouping, for example ["source", "service"]. Overrides group_by when provided.

category_v2.description: Alias for category, matching REST /data/events category_v2.

fields.description: Comma-separated event fields. Content fields are returned only when requested.

keyword.description: Alias for subject; filters titles/content when subject is not provided.

probe_chroma.description: When false, skip live Chroma probe (no_chroma=1).

type.description: Optional assertion_type filter (e.g. interest_topic, service, channel).
